about_the_game:
Fragment of Us: Encounter the Quirky Her

Have you ever dreamed of a sweet campus romance?

Fragment of Us takes you into a Japanese campus filled with cherry blossoms, where you’ll meet the quirky and charming high school girl—Nakano Aoi.

Nakano Aoi is a lively and curious girl with smooth silver hair and sparkling blue eyes that always gleam with mischief. She loves trying new things and often comes up with whimsical ideas.

Game Features:

  • Hundreds of Exquisite Images: From cherry blossom-filled campuses to romantic date spots, hundreds of beautifully crafted images present the most picturesque romantic scenes.

  • Immersive Couple Dialogues: Each scene comes with carefully designed dialogues, making you feel as if you’re truly there, experiencing sweet interactions with Nakano Aoi.

  • Fun Puzzle Gameplay: Complete puzzles to unlock more stunning images and hidden storylines, gradually uncovering little secrets between you and Nakano Aoi!

Gameplay:

  • Go on a Date with Her: Receive an unpredictable invitation from Nakano Aoi and embark on your romantic journey.

  • Complete Puzzles: Drag and place the fragments to complete the picture, unlocking exclusive memories with Nakano Aoi.

  • Enjoy the Story: After completing the puzzles, admire the beautiful images and sweet dialogues, immersing yourself in the beauty of romance.

Are you ready to start an unforgettable romantic journey with Nakano Aoi?

Fragment of Us awaits your challenge!
